entities.name: Umayyad Mosque of Mosul
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Umayyad Mosque of Mosul, also known as al-Atiq Mosque, was a large historic mosque in Mosul, Iraq, originally established in the 7th century. The mosque was demolished in 1810, after which the present-day al-Masfi Mosque was built on part of the site. The latter is also still known as the "Umayyad Mosque".
